name: smooth-cursor
title: Smooth Cursor
description: An arrow cursor glides between points on springs, turns to face where it travels and dips slightly while moving: the driver for 'a cursor uses the app' shots.

moworks.author: magicui

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: el is a layer over the scene (position absolute, inset 0); the cursor is drawn in it. path: [[t, x, y], ...] in s after `at` and px of el, linear between points (the springs smooth it). Any element can replace the arrow (put it inside el with class mw-sc-cursor).
moworks.titleVi: Con trỏ lướt mượt, xoay theo hướng đi
